resizableDoc.description: Accessible split-pane layouts with pointer and keyboard resizing.
resizableDoc.orientation: The resize axis. Horizontal is the default.
resizableDoc.defaultLayout: An initial layout map, useful when restoring a saved workspace.
resizableDoc.layoutChanged: Called after a completed pointer or keyboard resize.
resizableDoc.defaultSize: Initial panel size. Numbers are pixels; strings can use percentages or CSS units.
resizableDoc.minSize: Minimum panel size accepted by the resize interaction.
resizableDoc.maxSize: Maximum panel size accepted by the resize interaction.
resizableDoc.withHandle: Shows a quiet visual grip while keeping the full separator hit target.
resizableDoc.doubleClick: Set true to prevent double-clicking the separator from resetting its panels.
